MapLibre GL JS 5.12.0
https://github.com/maplibre/maplibre-gl-js/releases/tag/v5.12.0
https://registry.npmjs.org/maplibre-gl/-/maplibre-gl-5.12.0.tgz

The production CSP bundle and worker are named maplibre-gl.js and
maplibre-gl-worker.js locally. Source map comments were removed from the
JavaScript bundles. MapLibre-LICENSE.txt contains the distribution license
and third-party notices.

DM Sans and Spectral
https://registry.npmjs.org/@fontsource-variable/dm-sans/-/dm-sans-5.3.0.tgz
https://registry.npmjs.org/@fontsource/spectral/-/spectral-5.3.0.tgz

The Latin and Latin Extended WOFF2 files come from Fontsource 5.3.0.
The original SIL Open Font Licenses and copyright notices are included
under fonts/. The CSS shares the same locally hosted files between the
interface and the map labels.
